environment.measurementBoundary: One retained warm-up per layout followed by alternating AB/BA measured pairs; fresh JVM and GDB per sample. Warm-ups include first publication and script-cache initialization, and are excluded from medians. Export includes JVM startup, saved-program loading, decompilation, native production and publication. Import, validators and debugger time excluded from export. RSS is process-family high water, not aggregate memory. Fresh GDB symbol load, all-function lookup, scattered source listing and file-qualified breakpoint timings are separate. Caches and other host work are uncontrolled. No general speed or cold-cache claim.
